subject: Final OK: signature ownership, checklist & paperflow for NovaLytics POC
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha@novalytics.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Final signoff timeline and MAP for NovaLytics POC

Michael —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement and the engineering team asked for a consolidated mutual action plan (MAP) and a clear signoff timeline so we can align internal approvals. Two things we need from Redwood: 1) the final approval path you expect (who signs, legal review window), and 2) a proposed signature window + earliest start date for the POC. Procurement is tight on calendar — they want to lock the signature window by next Tuesday (9/28).

I attached the MAP your team shared last week with our notes (NovaLytics_MAP_v3.pdf). High level: we can approve the technical plan quickly but need clarity on SOC2 evidence and data-retention language before legal signs.

Can you confirm ownership and timelines so we can escalate?

Thanks,
Samantha Cho
Head of Data Platforms
NovaLytics

[Attachment: NovaLytics_MAP_v3.pdf (application/pdf, 320KB)]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@novalytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final signoff timeline and MAP for NovaLytics POC

Samantha — thanks for the note and the MAP with comments. Short answer: we can meet procurement's cadence if legal gets a 48-hour review window and we reserve an eSign slot the week of Oct 4.

Quick summary / proposal:
- Approval path: Samantha (POC owner) signs the MAP acknowledgement -> Procurement signs commercial SOW -> Redwood legal (Laura) does final review -> Redwood exec (me) completes signature if required.
- Legal review: 48 business hours for standard redlines; if additional SOC2 evidence required we can provision read-only logs and SOC2 SOC3 summary docs (we'll attach to the DocuSign envelope).
- Signature window: Propose Oct 4–6 for DocuSign routing (this gives procurement a full week after their internal approval on 9/28).
- Start date: Earliest execution start Oct 11 to allow our onboarding and infra ramp (two full business days after envelope completion).

I've attached the current SOW draft (SOW_Redwood_draft_v2.docx) with the commercial points we discussed. Laura / Camila — can you confirm you can turn around legal/ops checks on the proposed windows?

Action items: 
- Samantha: confirm NovaLytics can commit to signing by Oct 6 (we'll reserve DocuSign windows).
- Priyom: please prep the HubSpot deal record and mark tentative start Oct 11.
- Laura: flag any non-starter redlines by 9/24 EOD.
- Camila: verify onboarding PO availability for week of Oct 11.

Thanks — Michael
VP, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: SOW_Redwood_draft_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 48KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Cho <samantha@novalytics.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-23T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final signoff timeline and MAP for NovaLytics POC

Team — quick legal read:
- We can meet the 48-hour review target for the SOW and MAP if we get final redlines by EOD 9/24.
- Two items to flag now: (1) data retention clause — procurement asked for 7 years; standard Redwood position is 12 months for transitory logs, 7 years is a commercial negotiation (we can accept with DPA modification). (2) SOC2 evidence — we can provide a summarised SOC2 report and a scoped set of audit logs under an NDA; full SOC dossiers require an enterprise contract.

If procurement confirms the 9/28 internal approval, we should be able to route DocuSign 10/4–10/6. Please confirm the signer list. My recommended signer chain for the envelope: Samantha (acknowledgement) -> Procurement signer -> Redwood Legal (Laura) -> Redwood Exec (Michael) as the final counterparty. If procurement requires countersignature order changes, flag now.

— Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Cho <samantha@novalytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-24T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final signoff timeline and MAP for NovaLytics POC

Looping in ops notes — quoted below for context.

> Michael: "Start date: Earliest execution start Oct 11 to allow our onboarding and infra ramp"

We can commit to the Oct 11 start provided: 
- DocuSign completed by EOD Oct 6 so engineering schedules can be locked on Oct 7.
- Customer provides onboarding contact + required access credentials no later than Oct 8 morning.
- If the customer needs an earlier start we can do a partial-readonly dry run, but billed ramp begins Oct 11.

I will hold a 2-day onboarding engineer slot Oct 11–12. If students of timing — to avoid double-booking please confirm signature by Oct 6.

Camila Reyes
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Cho <samantha@novalytics.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novalytics.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-26T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final signoff timeline and MAP for NovaLytics POC

Michael / team —

Procurement confirmed internal authority on 9/28. We are comfortable with the Oct 4–6 envelope window, but there is one small ask: can the data retention clause be set to a 2-year default in the SOW, with an appendix for longer-retention customers? Procurement prefers that compromise.

If Redwood signs off on the 2-year default, NovaLytics will route the procurement signature the morning of 9/28. I attached the one-page signature page we plan to return once routed (Signature_Page.pdf).

We appreciate the responsiveness — please hold the DocuSign slots and confirm.

— Samantha

[Attachment: Signature_Page.pdf (application/pdf, 16KB)]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@novalytics.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novalytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-29T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final signoff timeline and MAP for NovaLytics POC — GO

This is the official GO from Redwood. Summary: 
- Data retention: accept 2-year default in SOW with an appendix for extended retention — legal to fold into final SOW.
- DocuSign window reserved: Oct 4–6 (we will open envelope 10/4 at 09:00 PT).
- Start date: Oct 11 for onboarding; Camila will run the schedule.

Next steps: 
1) Priyom — update HubSpot deal DEAL-2027-087 to "awaiting signature" and attach the SOW v2 with the updated retention appendix.
2) Laura — please prepare the final SOW + brief DPA addendum and confirm by 10/01 12:00 PT.
3) Camila — schedule the onboarding engineers and send the intake form to Samantha.
4) Samantha / Procurement — route the procurement signature on 9/28 morning so we can proceed.

DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/tx/abcdef123456
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-2027-087

Thanks all — looking forward to getting NovaLytics onboarded.

Best,
Michael Grant
